title: Thanking
subtitle: Dar las gracias
review: Written by Claude in Latin American (Mexican) Spanish. Check the Spanish, the English and the notes before recording audio. English support only.

categories.desc: From a quick gracias to real gratitude.
cards: Muchas gracias por la comida. Estuvo deliciosa.
Thank you very much for the meal. It was delicious.
Gracias por + a thing or a verb: gracias por venir.
Gracias por todo. Nos vemos pronto.
Thanks for everything. See you soon.
Literally 'a thousand thanks'. Warm and informal.
Thanks a million for the present!
More formal than gracias. With usted: se lo agradezco.
Te lo agradezco mucho, de verdad.

categories.desc: What to say when someone thanks you.
cards: A little warmer than de nada.
— Gracias por tu ayuda. — No hay de qué.
— Thanks for your help. — Don't mention it.
Common in shops and restaurants. Fuller: con mucho gusto.
— Could you bring me the check? — My pleasure.
Very Mexican and very polite, with usted.
— Thank you very much, sir. — At your service.
It hands the thanks back. With usted: gracias a usted.
— Gracias por venir. — Gracias a ti por invitarme.
— Thanks for coming. — Thank you for inviting me.

categories.desc: The small words that make a request or a refusal kind.
cards: At the start or the end of a request.
Said when someone does you a favor.
— Te ayudo con las bolsas. — Qué amable, gracias.
— Let me help you with the bags. — How kind, thank you.
— ¿Quieres más arroz? — No, gracias. Estoy lleno.
— Would you like more rice? — No, thank you. I'm full.
Said to anyone who is eating, even strangers at the next table. The answer: gracias, igualmente.
— Enjoy your meal! — Thanks, you too.
